votes.question: On Passage — National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 (H R 8800)
votes.bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 (H R 8800)

votes.plain_language: This bill widens the tax deduction for theft and fraud losses, including losses that are not from a declared disaster, and it eases related refund and retirement-plan rules. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — IRS Whistleblower Program Improvement Act (H R 7959)
votes.bill_title: IRS Whistleblower Program Improvement Act
votes.plain_language: This bill modifies provisions of the Internal Revenue Code relating to whistleblower awards and protections. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Expressing support for tax policies that support working families (H RES 1156)
votes.bill_title: Expressing support for tax policies that support working families.
votes.plain_language: This resolution expresses support for tax policies that support working families and recognizes the tax relief enacted as part of the 2025 reconciliation act. A Yea agrees to the resolution; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Adjourn (ADJOURN)
votes.plain_language: This was a motion to adjourn the House. A Yea votes to adjourn; a Nay votes to stay in session.

votes.question: Call of the House (QUORUM)
votes.plain_language: This was a quorum call, which records which members are present so the House can do business. It is not a vote on any measure. Members answer present; there is no Yea or Nay.

votes.question: On Passage — Removing Barriers to Work for Disabled Americans Act (H R 8884)
votes.bill_title: Removing Barriers to Work for Disabled Americans Act
votes.plain_language: This bill restarts Social Security disability demonstration projects through 2031 and says a participant's total income cannot be reduced. A Yea passes it. A Nay votes no.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Clergy Act (H R 227)
votes.bill_title: Clergy Act
votes.plain_language: This bill establishes a two-year window for certain members of the clergy and Christian Science practitioners to revoke their exemption from Social Security and Medicare taxes on ministerial earnings. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Agree — Calling on elected officials and civil society leaders to counter antisemitism and educate the public on the contributions of the Jewish-American community (H RES 1251)
votes.bill_title: Calling on elected officials and civil society leaders to counter antisemitism and educate the public on the contributions of the Jewish-American community.
votes.plain_language: This resolution calls on elected officials, faith leaders, and civil society leaders to condemn and counter acts of anti-Semitism. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports agreeing to it; a Nay opposes it.

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.
